summary: B (the new stylus close-up): a cartridge with rounded edges, cantilever and stylus, mounting screws and gold pins reads as a real part; full tonal range; warm reflections and shallow focus read as photographic. A (the current detail): primitive boxes, a blown background, upscaler smear, a cropped wordmark. Against B: a large dark lower half of blurred reflections, the label out of focus at the top left.
